title: Ban Bocor Lagi, Neng?
genre: Sundanese degung pop with suling and kendang
subject: a tukang tambal ban on a Lembang road patches the same girl's bicycle tyre every Saturday, and finds the puncture is always a neat pin hole, so he starts hiding a pin box and then hands her the last patch
caption: Sundanese degung pop, bouncy upbeat pulse. Bonang and saron playing bright interlocking figures, jenglong marking phrase ends, airy suling lead lines, kacapi arpeggios, kendang driving a lively groove, round electric bass. Clean airy studio recording. Male vocal, light bright tenor, playful sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, E minor. Cheeky and flirty mood. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no autotune, no dangdut koplo, no trap hats.
lyrics:
[Intro - suling, bonang]

[Verse 1]
Sabtu pagi kau datang dorong sepeda
Rambutmu basah kena kabut Lembang
Ban belakang kempes, kau senyum saja
Kubuka, kucari, ketemu lubang kecil

[Pre-Chorus]
Lubangnya rapi, bulat, sangat kecil
Seperti ditusuk jarum, Neng

[Chorus]
Ban bocor lagi, Neng, ban bocor lagi
Kuambil tambalan, kau pura-pura kaget
Ban bocor lagi, Neng, atuh jangan begitu
Kang tambal ban jadi gugup

[Verse 2]
Kuperiksa kotak jarum di bengkelku
Hilang satu, hilang dua, hilang lima
Kau tanya, Kang, kenapa melihatku begitu
Kujawab, tak apa, hanya sedang menghitung

[Pre-Chorus]
Kau tertawa, kau sembunyi di balik setang
Jarum itu ada di saku jaketmu

[Chorus]
Ban bocor lagi, Neng, ban bocor lagi
Kutambal sambil tak mau lekas selesai
Ban bocor lagi, Neng, atuh jangan begitu
Kang tambal ban sudah tahu

[Bridge - kendang, suling]
Sabtu depan tak usah tusuk lagi
Kuajak kau ngopi, ban kubiarkan utuh

[Chorus]
Ban tak bocor, Neng, ban tak bocor
Kutambal yang lain, hatiku yang bolong
Ban tak bocor, Neng, duduklah dulu
Kang tambal ban mau bicara

[Outro - suling, bonang fade]
